acceptance_criteria.text: Process an activity with Run mode and Running music -> the shuffle step sends only the duration-capped track list (~20 to 35 tracks, <= 150 minutes) to the child playlist ('Running (a)') on Spotify rather than all 400+ tracks from the parent playlist (covers B1) (pending OQ-2, OQ-3, OQ-5)

Run `auto_shuffle_playlists` for a playlist with a configured `minutes_to_sync` duration cap -> tracks sent to the target child playlist are limited to the duration cap rather than all tracks from the parent playlist (covers B2) (pending OQ-4)
